targets: every fighter on her side, each in its own dome

sizes.w: her ordinary fighters (Wardens and the rest)

delay.rule: the ring of light from the Wardens reaches each fighter: delay = ceil(distance to the nearest Warden / 70 px), distance measured with the vertical gap divided by 0.36 (the floor's squash)

order: tell ring from the windup start; at Release + delay the dark ring (1 frame); then the glass floor and the rise (8 frames); then the hold loop until the smash; a fighter waiting for his delay holds the tell's last frame

cues.release: at Release + 1 the Wardens flash white and the screen shakes [3, -1]
cues.tell: the Wardens get a 2 px teal rim on even frames in the tell's last second (tell frames 26 to 37)
cues.struck: a blow on a dome: steel_storm_struck_w, shake [2, -1] then [-2, 1]
cues.smash: smash frames 1 to 3: the screen shakes [[6, -3], [-6, 3], [3, -1]] and everyone on her side is pushed back 3, 2, 1 px

layers: the domes are drawn over each fighter (front), so a dome lower down covers the one above it, as in the take
